assertions.name: monotone_chain_triples_have_eps_xy_EQUAL_to_the_product
assertions.source: carrier + random monotone. This is the Lean's ChainTriple.eps_eq hypothesis and the only place monotonicity enters.

assertions.name: monotone_chain_triples_have_eps_yx_ZERO
assertions.source: the reverse ordering. Recorded because it is what a symmetrising scan sees, and what made me record my own correct prediction as refuted.

assertions.name: CONTROL_the_product_structure_FAILS_off_monotone
assertions.source: 22 of 78 non-monotone chain triples satisfy it. Without this the hypothesis would look like an identity rather than a consequence of monotonicity.

assertions.name: the_monotone_divisibility_is_NOT_vacuous
assertions.source: Delta >= 2 on 62 carrier and 144 random monotone chain triples. Delta = 1 would make the vanishing trivial, which is exactly the trap the non-monotone arm falls into.

assertions.name: CONTROL_off_monotone_a_chain_triple_ACTUALLY_carries_nonzero_mubar
assertions.source: of the 78 non-monotone chain triples exactly one has Delta >= 2, and divisibility fails on it. Without a counterexample the theorem would be indistinguishable from one whose hypothesis is never needed.

description: EXPLORATORY. Closes route 3's LAST residual -- the 31 chain triples the sibling OneSeparatedComponentSufficesForMilnorVanishing.lean isolates -- WITHOUT the connected-sum statement that sibling names as needed and that no held source in this corpus states. MEASURED: on a monotone closure the hub longitude's two far meridians occupy contiguous NON-INTERLEAVED blocks, so eps_{x,y}(lambda_hub) = u*v exactly (u = lk(hub,x), v = lk(hub,y)) and eps_{y,x} = 0 -- 62/62 on the carrier, 534/534 on random monotone words, against 18/71 and 21/71 off monotone. Since lk(x,y) = 0 on a chain, Delta = gcd(u,v), and gcd(u,v) | u | u*v UNCONDITIONALLY, so mubar vanishes. Every triple of the derived carrier is now covered: 393 by one separated component, 31 by this. CAUTION ON THE CONTROL: the non-monotone arm shows the HYPOTHESIS failing, not the CONCLUSION -- Delta = 1 in all 71 non-monotone chain triples, so divisibility is vacuous there; on the monotone side it is not (Delta >= 2 on 62/62 carrier and 144/534 random). Records that I predicted eps = u*v, then wrongly recorded it refuted because the symmetrised sum lands on the eps_{y,x} = 0 ordering. Scope (a) for the measurement; the scope-(b) exclusion lives in the Lean. Nothing wired.

what_this_replaces.the_sibling_left_open: the 31 chain triples of the derived carrier -- {i, i+1, i+2}, verified 62/62 in milnor_one_separated_component_and_the_chain_residual
what_this_replaces.what_it_said_would_close_them: mubar of length k vanishes unless all k indices lie in a single connected-sum summand -- a statement corpus-grep path 5 found in no held source
what_this_replaces.what_actually_closes_them: gcd(u,v) | u*v, an unconditional divisibility, given the measured block structure of a monotone closure's hub longitude
what_this_replaces.why_that_is_better: the input is smaller, more concrete, and checkable by counting -- 596/596, with an off-monotone control -- rather than a citation this corpus cannot supply

the_mechanism.chain: hub linked to both ends x, y; ends unlinked, so lk(x,y) = 0
the_mechanism.monotone_gives: one run per generator puts the two far meridians in contiguous non-interleaved blocks of lambda_hub, so the degree-2 Magnus coefficient is a product of block sums
the_mechanism.conclusion: gcd(u,v) | u | u*v, unconditionally in u and v

order_dependence_is_the_point.the_alarming_fact: the raw coefficient is u*v one way and 0 the other, which looks fatal for something called an invariant
order_dependence_is_the_point.the_resolution: that is exactly what the mod-Delta indeterminacy absorbs -- BOTH values are divisible by Delta, so the invariant is well defined and zero either way

my_prediction_and_my_wrong_refutation.predicted: raw mubar = u*v, vanishing only mod Delta
my_prediction_and_my_wrong_refutation.apparently_refuted_by: the symmetrised sum computed by milnor_mubar_vanishes_on_every_triple_probe.py gives an honest integer 0 on 62/62 and 534/534
my_prediction_and_my_wrong_refutation.why_the_refutation_was_wrong: that symmetrisation lands on eps_{y,x}, the ordering that IS 0. The ordering carrying the content is eps_{x,y} = u*v
my_prediction_and_my_wrong_refutation.the_lesson: a scan that symmetrises can turn a general mechanism into what looks like a coincidence; only breaking the sum into its three terms separated them

the_off_monotone_control_is_a_REAL_count.hypothesis_fails: eps = u*v on only 22 of 78 non-monotone chain triples
the_off_monotone_control_is_a_REAL_count.and_so_does_the_conclusion: 1 of them is NOT divisible by Delta -- a genuine chain triple carrying nonzero mubar. That is what makes eps_eq load-bearing rather than decorative
the_off_monotone_control_is_a_REAL_count.the_rest_are_vacuous: the other triples have Delta = 1, where 1 divides everything -- report that separately or the control reads as stronger than it is
the_off_monotone_control_is_a_REAL_count.a_figure_I_got_wrong: I first recorded 'all 71 non-monotone chain triples have Delta = 1', from a scratch run building a fresh seeded RNG per arm. This probe uses ONE RNG consumed sequentially, matching the #6679 genericity probe so the arms are comparable: 71 -> 78, and the counterexample appears. Same trap as #6679's 251/2080

q0AnchorReason: reads no q0. Inputs are braid words, their closures' permutation cycles, integer linking numbers and degree-2 Magnus coefficients. No substrate pin is evaluated on any path.
